data_window: FY2020/21 - FY2025/26 (must include the ~25% credit peak of FY2020/21 and the 2021-22 correction); monthly preferred, annual minimum
method: Lagged cross-correlation of NRB 'Claims on Private Sector (y-o-y)' monthly/quarterly vs NEPSE index returns, lags 0-18 months; report correlation at each lag; additionally re-run the book's own 2021 case (ch-0-1:119: '3-6 months of warning') as a single-event check. No look-ahead: use only data published before each month's decision date.
criteria: PASS (claim upgraded toward FACT-VERIFIED-with-caveats) iff: (a) mean |correlation| at lags 3-12 materially exceeds lags 0-2 and 15-18 (lead structure present), and (b) the 2021 case reproduces a warning of 3-6+ months before the correction. FAIL (claim must be downgraded to 'hypothesis' language, 02-status-taxonomy ceiling) if no lag structure or the 2021 case fails. INCONCLUSIVE if data window insufficient (e.g., only 4 annual points).
limitations: NRB tables currently yield annual series FY2022/23-25/26 (4.6/6.1/8.1/6.6 pct private credit) only - 4 annual points is INCONCLUSIVE by design; monthly annex (Table 70) and FY2020/21-FY2021/22 still to be fetched (SRC-0017).
